crossRefs.note: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you…
For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the…
Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his…
“Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?
But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self…
By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.
